thread:
anna: Heads up — noticed a 12% p99 regression on mixtral-moe-prod after yesterday's kernel selector change. CPU-side latency looks fine, GPU kernel mix shifted to slow_softmax_kernel for many hot routes.

mike: ugh. which change specifically? selector rules or kernel binary roll? :grimacing:

anna: selector thresholds got relaxed to prefer kernel_v2 for compatibility (change landed in infra-kernel-chooser #412). heuristic now picks kernel_v2 for seq<=256 when head_dim>64. seems to misfire for mixtral with RoPE scaling.

rachel: can you paste a short trace / kernel timeline? curious about batching vs single-token slowdowns.

anna: pasted snippet from trace-log:
```
2026-03-17T21:02:11Z INFO route=eu-west-1/model=mixtral-moe kernel=slow_softmax_kernel time_ms=3.9 batch_size=1 seq_len=64 heads=96 kv_cache_hit=true
2026-03-17T21:02:11Z INFO route=eu-west-1/model=mixtral-moe kernel=fast_kernel_v1 time_ms=1.1 batch_size=4 seq_len=64 heads=96 kv_cache_hit=false
```
Looks like when KV cache hits occur and batch size collapses to 1, selector picks slow_softmax_kernel which is ~3.5x slower for single-token hotpath.

jorge: that matches local repro. When router_logits produce topk=1 affinity, we see more single-token batches from the same client (prefix cached), so kernel choice matters more. Also RoPE scaling increases compute per-head slightly so head_dim>64 heuristic becomes brittle.

perf-bot: perf alert: mixtral-moe-prod p99 increased from 84ms -> 94ms (12.2%) over 6h window. Regression correlated with infra-kernel-chooser@v2.3 rollout.

mike: short term: revert the selector relaxation for Mixtral models only. Add model-specific override: models.mixtral.* -> force prefer fast_kernel_v1 for batch_size<=4 or kv_cache_hit=true. /cc @infra

rachel: agree. medium term: improve selector to consider kv_cache_hit + router_topk + observed batch_size distribution. maybe a tiny ML model or simple score function instead of hard thresholds.

anna: experiment plan I ran locally:
1) change selector: if (kv_cache_hit == true && batch_size <= 2) -> prefer fast_kernel_v1
2) add metric: kernel_choice_count per-route
3) run 1h canary on 10% traffic

config diff I tried:
```
selector.rules:
  - name: prefer_fast_for_kv
    match: model_family == "mixtral" && kv_cache_hit == true && batch_size <= 2
    kernel: fast_kernel_v1
```

jorge: tests: run `perf-runner --trace-kernel mixtral-moe --duration 60 --route eu-west-1` and check p99 & kernel mix. I can attach flame graphs after smoke.

perf-bot: canary results (simulated): p99 improved back to 86ms, kernel_v1 share +42%, slow_softmax_kernel down to 8% of calls.

mike: if canary looks good, roll a targeted override to prod and then follow up with selector improvement ticket. create rollout playbook for oncall (steps + revert).

rachel: also add router-side tweak: try topk=2 soft-fallback for a subset to increase batchability — may reduce single-token hotpath pressure.

anna: noted. opening infra issue and targeting a limited patch tonight. I'll post quick followup with canary logs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
